"""Candidate Normative Code Block for Detailed Design §3."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import datetime
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import math
import os
import re
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Annotated, Any, Dict, List, Literal, Optional, Tuple, Union
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
from pydantic import (
    BaseModel,
    ConfigDict,
    Field,
    StringConstraints,
    ValidationInfo,
    field_validator,
    model_validator,
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strict ID and Path Constraints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SafeId = Annotated[
    str,
    StringConstraints(
        min_length=1,
        max_length=64,
        pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$",
    ),
]

SafePath = Annotated[
    str,
    StringConstraints(
        min_length=1,
        max_length=256,
        pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\./]+$",
    ),
]

TypedNotePathRegex = re.compile(
    r"^memory/typed/(semantic|episodic|procedural|failure_lesson)/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.md$"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) Implementation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

try:
    import rfc8785
    _HAS_RFC8785 = True
except ImportError:
    _HAS_RFC8785 = False

def to_canonical_json_dict(obj: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively convert Pydantic models, dates, datetimes, and complex types to JSON-compatible primitives."""
    if hasattr(obj, "model_dump"):
        return obj.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False)
    if isinstance(obj, (datetime.date, datetime.datetime)):
        return obj.isoformat()
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: to_canonical_json_dict(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [to_canonical_json_dict(v) for v in obj]
    return obj

def canonical_jcs_bytes(data: Any) -> bytes:
    """Serialize data into RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) UTF-8 bytes."""
    if not _HAS_RFC8785:
        raise RuntimeError("Operational error: rfc8785==0.1.4 package is required for typed memory integrity")
    json_data = to_canonical_json_dict(data)
    encoded = rfc8785.dumps(json_data)
    return encoded if isinstance(encoded, bytes) else encoded.encode("utf-8")

def sha256_canonical(data: Any) -> str:
    """Compute SHA-256 hex digest of RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes."""
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_jcs_bytes(data)).hexdigest()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workspace Containment & Structural URI Admission
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ALLOWED_URI_SCHEMES = ("file", "session")
WINDOWS_DRIVE_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:[A-Za-z]:[\\/]|/[A-Za-z]:[\\/])")

def _reject_windows_or_unsafe_uri_path(path: str) -> None:
    decoded = urllib.parse.unquote(path)
    if "\\" in decoded:
        raise ValueError("backslash/Windows path syntax is not accepted")
    if decoded.startswith(("//?/", "\\\\?\\")) or decoded.startswith("//"):
        raise ValueError("UNC or extended Windows path syntax is not accepted")
    if WINDOWS_DRIVE_RE.match(decoded):
        raise ValueError("Windows drive path syntax is not accepted")
    parts = decoded.split("/")
    if parts and parts[0] == "":
        parts = parts[1:]
    if any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parts):
        raise ValueError("URI path contains an unsafe component")

def admit_source_uri(
    source_uri: str,
    *,
    workspace_dir: str | Path,
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Path:
    """Mandatory application-level source URI admission and workspace confinement."""
    if not source_uri or not isinstance(source_uri, str):
        raise ValueError("URI must be a non-empty string")
    if not isinstance(workspace_dir, (str, Path)) or not str(workspace_dir):
        raise ValueError("workspace_dir is mandatory application admission context")

    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(source_uri)
    if parsed.scheme not in ALLOWED_URI_SCHEMES:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid source_uri scheme: {source_uri!r}. Permitted schemes: {ALLOWED_URI_SCHEMES}. "
            "git://, http://, https://, and ftp:// are strictly prohibited."
        )
    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.username or parsed.password:
        raise ValueError(f"source URI may not contain query, fragment, or credentials: {source_uri!r}")

    _reject_windows_or_unsafe_uri_path(parsed.path)
    ws_path = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    if not ws_path.is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f"Application workspace_dir must be an existing directory: {workspace_dir!r}")

    if parsed.scheme == "file":
        if parsed.netloc not in {"", "localhost"}:
            raise ValueError(f"file URI must not name a remote host: {source_uri!r}")
        if not parsed.path.startswith("/"):
            raise ValueError(f"file URI must have an absolute local path: {source_uri!r}")
        raw_path = Path(urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path))
        if not raw_path.is_relative_to(ws_path):
            raise ValueError(f"file URI escapes workspace_dir: {raw_path!r} outside {ws_path!r}")
        curr = raw_path
        while curr != ws_path and curr != curr.parent:
            if curr.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError(f"Symlink rejected in workspace path: {curr!r}")
            curr = curr.parent
        return raw_path

    elif parsed.scheme == "session":
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", parsed.netloc or ""):
            raise ValueError(f"session URI authority must be a lowercase SHA-256: {source_uri!r}")
        if urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path) != "/dialog.jsonl":
            raise ValueError(f"session URI path must be /dialog.jsonl: {source_uri!r}")
        if not isinstance(session_id, str) or not session_id:
            raise ValueError("session_id is mandatory for session URI admission")
        expected_authority = hashlib.sha256(session_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        if parsed.netloc != expected_authority:
            raise ValueError(f"Session URI authority mismatch: expected {expected_authority}, got {parsed.netloc}")
        raw_target = ws_path / ".reme" / "sessions" / parsed.netloc / "dialog.jsonl"
        if not raw_target.is_relative_to(ws_path):
            raise ValueError(f"session URI escapes workspace_dir: {raw_target!r}")
        curr = raw_target
        while curr != ws_path and curr != curr.parent:
            if curr.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError(f"Symlink rejected in session path: {curr!r}")
            curr = curr.parent
        return raw_target

    raise ValueError(f"Unhandled URI scheme: {source_uri!r}")

def safe_open_source(
    path_or_uri: Path | str,
    *,
    workspace_dir: Path | str,
    operation: str = "load",
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> int:
    """Open verified source path with descriptor-relative component walking and O_NOFOLLOW to prevent TOCTOU symlink traversal."""
    if operation not in ("commit", "load"):
        raise ValueError("operation must be 'commit' or 'load'")
    ws_path = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    if isinstance(path_or_uri, str) and ("://" in path_or_uri or path_or_uri.startswith("file:") or path_or_uri.startswith("session:")):
        target = admit_source_uri(path_or_uri, workspace_dir=ws_path, session_id=session_id)
    else:
        p = Path(path_or_uri)
        if p.is_absolute():
            if not p.is_relative_to(ws_path):
                raise ValueError(f"Security violation: absolute path outside workspace: {p}")
            target = p
        else:
            if ".." in p.parts or "." in p.parts:
                raise ValueError(f"Security violation: path traversal components '.' or '..' detected: {path_or_uri!r}")
            target = ws_path / p
        if not target.is_relative_to(ws_path):
            raise ValueError(f"Security violation: path outside workspace: {target}")
        curr = target
        while curr != ws_path and curr != curr.parent:
            if curr.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError(f"Security violation: symlink rejected in source path: {curr}")
            curr = curr.parent
    
    rel = target.relative_to(ws_path)
    flags_dir = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
    current_fd = os.open(ws_path, flags_dir)
    try:
        parts = rel.parts
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            next_fd = os.open(part, flags_dir | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0), dir_fd=current_fd)
            os.close(current_fd)
            current_fd = next_fd
        flags_file = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
        file_fd = os.open(parts[-1], flags_file, dir_fd=current_fd)
        return file_fd
    finally:
        try:
            os.close(current_fd)
        except OSError:
            pass

def safe_write_note(
    rel_note_path: str,
    content: str,
    *,
    workspace_dir: Path | str,
) -> Path:
    """Safely commit a note file using descriptor-relative component walking and O_NOFOLLOW to prevent symlink traversal."""
    if not rel_note_path or not isinstance(rel_note_path, str):
        raise ValueError("rel_note_path must be a non-empty string")
    ws_path = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    raw_rel = Path(rel_note_path)
    if raw_rel.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: commit path must be workspace-relative, got absolute path: {rel_note_path}")
    
    parts = raw_rel.parts
    if not parts or any(p in ("..", ".", "") for p in parts):
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: traversal component in commit path: {rel_note_path}")
    
    curr_check = ws_path
    for part in parts[:-1]:
        curr_check = curr_check / part
        if curr_check.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"Security violation: parent directory in commit path is a symlink: {curr_check}")
    
    target_file = (ws_path / raw_rel).resolve()
    if not target_file.is_relative_to(ws_path):
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: commit path escapes workspace: {rel_note_path}")
    
    flags_dir = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
    current_fd = os.open(ws_path, flags_dir)
    try:
        curr_dir = ws_path
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            curr_dir = curr_dir / part
            if curr_dir.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError(f"Security violation: parent directory in commit path is a symlink: {curr_dir}")
            curr_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            next_fd = os.open(part, flags_dir | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0), dir_fd=current_fd)
            os.close(current_fd)
            current_fd = next_fd
        
        if target_file.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"Security violation: target note path is a symlink: {target_file}")
            
        tmp_name = f".{parts[-1]}.{os.getpid()}.tmp"
        flags_create = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
        file_fd = os.open(tmp_name, flags_create, 0o644, dir_fd=current_fd)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(file_fd, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(content.encode("utf-8"))
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        except Exception:
            try:
                os.close(file_fd)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise
            
        tmp_path = target_file.parent / tmp_name
        os.replace(tmp_path, target_file)
        os.fsync(current_fd)
        return target_file
    finally:
        try:
            os.close(current_fd)
        except OSError:
            pass

def validate_workspace_containment(uri: str, info: Optional[ValidationInfo] = None) -> str:
    """Pydantic-layer field validator invoking admit_source_uri when context is present."""
    if not uri or not isinstance(uri, str):
        raise ValueError("URI must be a non-empty string")
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(uri)
    if parsed.scheme not in ALLOWED_URI_SCHEMES:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid scheme: {uri!r}. Permitted: {ALLOWED_URI_SCHEMES}")
    if info is not None and info.context and "workspace_dir" in info.context:
        admit_source_uri(uri, workspace_dir=info.context["workspace_dir"], session_id=info.context.get("session_id"))
    return uri

def admit_and_commit_record(
    record: Any,
    *,
    workspace_dir: Path | str,
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ledger_entries: Optional[Dict[str, HmacLedgerEntry]] = None,
    key_manager: Optional[ExternalKeyManager] = None,
    verifier: Optional[LedgerVerifier] = None,
) -> Path:
    """Mandatory application commit adapter: validates provenance admission, verifies owner authority, and commits via descriptor-safe writer."""
    ws = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    for citation in getattr(record, "provenance", []):
        admit_source_uri(citation.source_uri, workspace_dir=ws, session_id=session_id)
    
    if getattr(record, "trust_tier", None) == "owner_approved":
        if ledger_entries is None or key_manager is None or verifier is None:
            raise ValueError("OWNER_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE: ledger_entries, key_manager, and verifier are mandatory to commit owner_approved records")
        verify_runtime_owner_authority(
            record,
            ledger_entries,
            key_manager,
            verifier,
            workspace_id=record.workspace_id,
            profile_id=record.profile_id,
            is_commit=True,
            advance_watermark=False,
        )
    
    body = render_markdown_body(record)
    target_path = safe_write_note(record.note_path, body, workspace_dir=ws)
    if getattr(record, "trust_tier", None) == "owner_approved":
        entry = ledger_entries[record.authority_entry_id]
        verifier.durable_ledger.advance(verifier.stream_key(entry), entry.seq)
    return target_path

def admit_and_load_record(
    note_path: Path | str,
    *,
    workspace_dir: Path | str,
    record: Optional[Any] = None,
    ledger_entries: Optional[Dict[str, HmacLedgerEntry]] = None,
    key_manager: Optional[ExternalKeyManager] = None,
    verifier: Optional[LedgerVerifier] = None,
) -> str:
    """Mandatory application load adapter: opens verified source with safe descriptor walking and performs mandatory owner validation."""
    ws = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    fd = safe_open_source(note_path, workspace_dir=ws, operation="load")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            raw_text = handle.read()
    except Exception:
        try:
            os.close(fd)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise
        
    if record is not None:
        rec_body_hash = getattr(record, "body_sha256", None)
        if rec_body_hash is not None:
            actual_body_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
            if actual_body_hash != rec_body_hash:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"TAMPER_DETECTED: Note body on disk hash {actual_body_hash} contradicts committed record.body_sha256 {rec_body_hash}"
                )
        if getattr(record, "trust_tier", None) == "owner_approved":
            if ledger_entries is None or key_manager is None or verifier is None:
                raise ValueError("OWNER_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE: ledger_entries, key_manager, and verifier are mandatory to load owner_approved records")
            verify_runtime_owner_authority(
                record,
                ledger_entries,
                key_manager,
                verifier,
                workspace_id=record.workspace_id,
                profile_id=record.profile_id,
                is_commit=False,
                advance_watermark=False,
            )
    return raw_text

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Typed Enumerations & Sub-Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

StatusType = Literal["active", "superseded", "retracted", "archived"]
ConfidenceLevel = Literal["high", "medium", "low"]
SourceClass = Literal[
    "authoritative_record",      # AR
    "agent_observation",         # AO
    "derived_summary",           # DS
    "model_claim",               # MC
    "unverified_output",         # UO
    "owner_preference",          # OP (Disabled in Phase B)
    "constitutional_rule",       # CR (Disabled in Phase B)
]
TrustTier = Literal["untrusted", "verified", "owner_approved"]

class SourceHash(BaseModel):
    """Bounded, typed hash commitment for source files and commits."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    git_commit: Optional[str] = Field(None, pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$")
    line_count: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=100_000)

class ProvenanceCitation(BaseModel):
    """Fine-grained cryptographic provenance linking memory to source events."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    source_uri: str = Field(..., max_length=1024)
    line_start: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=1_000_000)
    line_end: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=1_000_000)
    verbatim_quote: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    source_class: SourceClass = Field(default="agent_observation")
    session_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    transcript_hash: Optional[str] = Field(None, pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    source_hash: Optional[SourceHash] = None
    
    @field_validator("source_uri")
    @classmethod
    def check_uri(cls, v: str, info: ValidationInfo) -> str:
        return validate_workspace_containment(v, info)
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def check_line_ordering(self) -> ProvenanceCitation:
        if self.line_start is not None and self.line_end is not None:
            if self.line_start > self.line_end:
                raise ValueError(f"line_start ({self.line_start}) > line_end ({self.line_end})")
        return self

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discriminated Typed Content Schemas
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class SemanticContent(BaseModel):
    """Category 1: Attributable facts, configuration constraints, world knowledge."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    record_type: Literal["semantic"] = "semantic"
    fact: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    entity: Optional[SafeId] = None
    attribute: Optional[SafeId] = None
    value: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=2048)
    confidence: ConfidenceLevel = Field(default="high")
    valid_from: Optional[datetime.date] = None
    valid_until: Optional[datetime.date] = None
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def check_validity_dates(self) -> SemanticContent:
        if self.valid_from and self.valid_until and self.valid_from > self.valid_until:
            raise ValueError(f"valid_from ({self.valid_from}) > valid_until ({self.valid_until})")
        return self

class EpisodicContent(BaseModel):
    """Category 2: Time-ordered actions, observations, outcomes, and actors."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    record_type: Literal["episodic"] = "episodic"
    event_summary: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    occurred_at: datetime.datetime = Field(...)
    actors: List[SafeId] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=20)
    action: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=2048)
    outcome: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=2048)
    sequence_order: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=100_000)

class ProceduralContent(BaseModel):
    """Category 3: Operational workflows, execution parameters, ordered steps, rollback."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    record_type: Literal["procedural"] = "procedural"
    task_name: SafeId = Field(...)
    prerequisites: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=50)
    parameters: Dict[SafeId, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    steps: List[str] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    verification_command: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=1024)
    rollback_steps: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=50)
    
    @field_validator("parameters")
    @classmethod
    def check_param_limits(cls, v: Dict[SafeId, str]) -> Dict[SafeId, str]:
        if len(v) > 50:
            raise ValueError(f"Parameters dict exceeds max keys (50): got {len(v)}")
        for key, val in v.items():
            if len(val) > 4096:
                raise ValueError(f"Parameter {key!r} value exceeds max chars (4096)")
        return v

class FailureLessonContent(BaseModel):
    """Category 4: Observed failure symptoms, triggers, root causes, prevention rules."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    record_type: Literal["failure_lesson"] = "failure_lesson"
    failure_symptom: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    trigger: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=2048)
    root_cause: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    root_cause_status: Literal["hypothesized", "verified"] = Field(default="hypothesized")
    verification_receipt_id: Optional[SafeId] = None
    immediate_remediation: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    prevention_rule: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4096)
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def check_verified_receipt(self) -> FailureLessonContent:
        if self.root_cause_status == "verified" and not self.verification_receipt_id:
            raise ValueError("root_cause_status 'verified' requires a valid verification_receipt_id")
        return self

TypedContent = Annotated[
    Union[SemanticContent, EpisodicContent, ProceduralContent, FailureLessonContent],
    Field(discriminator="record_type"),
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deterministic Markdown Body Renderer
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MARKDOWN_ESCAPED_CHARS = r"\`#[]()<>!*_~|+-"

def escape_markdown(text: str) -> str:
    """Strict escaping of Markdown special characters and literal newlines."""
    text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    text = text.replace("\n", r"\n")
    return "".join((f"\\{c}" if c in MARKDOWN_ESCAPED_CHARS else c) for c in text)

def format_field_val(val: Any) -> str:
    """Format any field value deterministically, explicitly distinguishing None from empty strings."""
    if val is None:
        return "<null>"
    if isinstance(val, (datetime.date, datetime.datetime)):
        return val.isoformat()
    if isinstance(val, list):
        return "[" + ", ".join(format_field_val(x) for x in val) + "]"
    if isinstance(val, dict):
        items = [f"{escape_markdown(k)}={format_field_val(v)}" for k, v in sorted(val.items())]
        return "{" + ", ".join(items) + "}"
    if isinstance(val, str):
        return f'"{escape_markdown(val)}"'
    return str(val)

def render_markdown_body(record: Any) -> str:
    """Deterministically render canonical Markdown body with fixed Identity, Lifecycle, Content, and Provenance sections.
    
    Every schema-controlled field is explicitly projected with distinct representation for None vs empty string.
    """
    lines: List[str] = [
        f"# Typed Memory Record: {escape_markdown(str(getattr(record, 'memory_id', '')))}",
        "",
        "## Identity",
        "",
        f"- memory_id: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'memory_id', None))}",
        f"- record_type: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'record_type', None))}",
        f"- status: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'status', 'active'))}",
        f"- trust_tier: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'trust_tier', 'verified'))}",
        f"- revision_seq: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'revision_seq', 1))}",
        f"- workspace_id: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'workspace_id', None))}",
        f"- profile_id: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'profile_id', None))}",
        f"- project_id: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'project_id', None))}",
        f"- authority_entry_id: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'authority_entry_id', None))}",
        "",
        "## Lifecycle",
        "",
        f"- created_at_utc: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'created_at_utc', None))}",
        f"- updated_at_utc: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'updated_at_utc', None))}",
        f"- supersedes_id: {format_field_val(getattr(record, 'supersedes_id', None))}",
        "",
        "## Content",
        "",
    ]
    
    content = getattr(record, "typed_content", None)
    if isinstance(content, SemanticContent):
        lines.extend([
            f"- fact: {format_field_val(content.fact)}",
            f"- entity: {format_field_val(content.entity)}",
            f"- attribute: {format_field_val(content.attribute)}",
            f"- value: {format_field_val(content.value)}",
            f"- confidence: {format_field_val(content.confidence)}",
            f"- valid_from: {format_field_val(content.valid_from)}",
            f"- valid_until: {format_field_val(content.valid_until)}",
        ])
    elif isinstance(content, EpisodicContent):
        lines.extend([
            f"- event_summary: {format_field_val(content.event_summary)}",
            f"- occurred_at: {format_field_val(content.occurred_at)}",
            f"- actors: {format_field_val(content.actors)}",
            f"- action: {format_field_val(content.action)}",
            f"- outcome: {format_field_val(content.outcome)}",
            f"- sequence_order: {format_field_val(content.sequence_order)}",
        ])
    elif isinstance(content, ProceduralContent):
        lines.extend([
            f"- task_name: {format_field_val(content.task_name)}",
            f"- prerequisites: {format_field_val(content.prerequisites)}",
            f"- parameters: {format_field_val(content.parameters)}",
            f"- steps: {format_field_val(content.steps)}",
            f"- verification_command: {format_field_val(content.verification_command)}",
            f"- rollback_steps: {format_field_val(content.rollback_steps)}",
        ])
    elif isinstance(content, FailureLessonContent):
        lines.extend([
            f"- failure_symptom: {format_field_val(content.failure_symptom)}",
            f"- trigger: {format_field_val(content.trigger)}",
            f"- root_cause_status: {format_field_val(content.root_cause_status)}",
            f"- root_cause: {format_field_val(content.root_cause)}",
            f"- verification_receipt_id: {format_field_val(content.verification_receipt_id)}",
            f"- immediate_remediation: {format_field_val(content.immediate_remediation)}",
            f"- prevention_rule: {format_field_val(content.prevention_rule)}",
        ])
        
    lines.extend(["", "## Provenance", ""])
    for i, p in enumerate(getattr(record, "provenance", []), start=1):
        lines.extend([
            f"- citation_{i}_source_class: {format_field_val(p.source_class)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_source_uri: {format_field_val(p.source_uri)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_session_id: {format_field_val(p.session_id)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_verbatim_quote: {format_field_val(p.verbatim_quote)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_line_start: {format_field_val(p.line_start)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_line_end: {format_field_val(p.line_end)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_transcript_hash: {format_field_val(p.transcript_hash)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_source_sha256: {format_field_val(p.source_hash.sha256 if p.source_hash else None)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_git_commit: {format_field_val(p.source_hash.git_commit if p.source_hash else None)}",
            f"- citation_{i}_line_count: {format_field_val(p.source_hash.line_count if p.source_hash else None)}",
        ])
    lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def compute_body_sha256(record: Any) -> str:
    """Compute deterministic SHA-256 hex digest of the rendered Markdown body."""
    body_text = render_markdown_body(record)
    return hashlib.sha256(body_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immutable Application-Owned Memory Record
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TypedMemoryRecord(BaseModel):
    """Application-owned, immutable memory record published to durable storage."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    memory_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    record_type: Literal["semantic", "episodic", "procedural", "failure_lesson"] = Field(...)
    status: StatusType = Field(default="active")
    revision_seq: int = Field(default=1, ge=1, le=100_000)
    workspace_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    profile_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=128)
    project_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=128, pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+$")
    supersedes_id: Optional[SafeId] = None
    typed_content: TypedContent = Field(...)
    provenance: List[ProvenanceCitation] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    trust_tier: TrustTier = Field(default="verified")
    authority_entry_id: Optional[SafeId] = Field(None, description="External HMAC ledger entry ID binding for owner-authorized records.")
    
    # Cryptographic commitments
    content_hash: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    body_sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    record_digest: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    
    # Metadata
    note_path: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^memory/typed/(semantic|episodic|procedural|failure_lesson)/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.md$")
    created_at_utc: str = Field(...)
    updated_at_utc: str = Field(...)
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_record_invariants(self) -> TypedMemoryRecord:
        # 1. Type matching
        if self.typed_content.record_type != self.record_type:
            raise ValueError(f"Content record_type ({self.typed_content.record_type}) != record_type ({self.record_type})")
        
        # 1b. Q1/Q3 Authority binding
        if self.trust_tier == "owner_approved":
            if not self.authority_entry_id:
                raise ValueError("Records claiming trust_tier='owner_approved' must bind to a valid authority_entry_id in the external HMAC ledger")
            if not self.profile_id:
                raise ValueError("Records claiming trust_tier='owner_approved' must have explicit profile_id")
        if self.authority_entry_id and self.trust_tier != "owner_approved":
            raise ValueError("authority_entry_id cannot be attached to non-owner records")
        
        # 2. Content hash commitment verification
        expected_content_hash = sha256_canonical(self.typed_content.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False))
        if self.content_hash != expected_content_hash:
            raise ValueError(f"content_hash mismatch: expected {expected_content_hash}, got {self.content_hash}")
        
        # 3. Deterministic ID binding: mem_<type>_<sha256(canonical_typed_content)[:16]>
        expected_memory_id = f"mem_{self.record_type}_{expected_content_hash[:16]}"
        if self.memory_id != expected_memory_id:
            raise ValueError(f"Deterministic memory_id mismatch: expected {expected_memory_id}, got {self.memory_id}")
        
        # 4. Deterministic note_path binding
        expected_note_path = f"memory/typed/{self.record_type}/{self.memory_id}.md"
        if self.note_path != expected_note_path:
            raise ValueError(f"Deterministic note_path mismatch: expected {expected_note_path}, got {self.note_path}")
        
        # 5. Stored body hash verification (C3-03 / F-05)
        expected_body_sha256 = compute_body_sha256(self)
        if self.body_sha256 != expected_body_sha256:
            raise ValueError(f"body_sha256 mismatch: expected {expected_body_sha256}, got {self.body_sha256}")
        
        # 6. Non-circular record digest verification
        dumped = self.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False)
        data_for_digest = {
            k: v for k, v in dumped.items()
            if k not in ("record_digest", "_reme_commit")
        }
        expected_record_digest = sha256_canonical(data_for_digest)
        if self.record_digest != expected_record_digest:
            raise ValueError(f"record_digest mismatch: expected {expected_record_digest}, got {self.record_digest}")
        
        # 7. Aggregate envelope size check (<= 64 KB)
        envelope_bytes = canonical_jcs_bytes(dumped)
        if len(envelope_bytes) > 65_536:
            raise ValueError(f"Record envelope exceeds 64 KB limit: {len(envelope_bytes)} bytes")
            
        return self

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Untrusted Model Proposal Schema
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TypedMemoryProposal(BaseModel):
    """Untrusted memory proposal submitted by an LLM agent for evolution/commit."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    
    record_type: Literal["semantic", "episodic", "procedural", "failure_lesson"] = Field(...)
    source_class: SourceClass = Field(default="agent_observation")
    typed_content: TypedContent = Field(...)
    provenance: List[ProvenanceCitation] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=50)
    session_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    supersedes_id: Optional[SafeId] = None
    project_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=128)
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_proposal(self) -> TypedMemoryProposal:
        # Phase B Owner Q3 Gate: Creation of OP/CR is strictly forbidden
        if self.source_class in ("owner_preference", "constitutional_rule"):
            raise ValueError(
                f"SourceClass {self.source_class!r} creation is strictly prohibited in Phase B (Owner Gate Q3). "
                "Only verified agent observations and authoritative transcripts may be committed."
            )
        
        if self.typed_content.record_type != self.record_type:
            raise ValueError(f"Content record_type ({self.typed_content.record_type}) != proposal record_type ({self.record_type})")
        
        return self

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Option B Frontmatter Marker and Receipt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class OptionBMarker(BaseModel):
    """Application-owned frontmatter marker embedded in persisted markdown files."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    version: str = Field(default="v2")
    request_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    session_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    memory_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    record_type: Literal["semantic", "episodic", "procedural", "failure_lesson"] = Field(...)
    content_hash: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    body_sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    record_digest: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    created: bool = Field(default=True)
    provenance_incomplete: bool = Field(default=False)

class OptionBReceiptCommit(BaseModel):
    """Individual commit confirmation within an Option B transaction receipt."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    memory_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    record_type: Literal["semantic", "episodic", "procedural", "failure_lesson"] = Field(...)
    record_digest: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    body_sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    note_path: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^memory/typed/(semantic|episodic|procedural|failure_lesson)/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.md$")
    status: StatusType = Field(default="active")
    revision_seq: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    created: bool = Field(...)
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_commit(self) -> OptionBReceiptCommit:
        expected_note_path = f"memory/typed/{self.record_type}/{self.memory_id}.md"
        if self.note_path != expected_note_path:
            raise ValueError(f"note_path mismatch: expected {expected_note_path}, got {self.note_path}")
        return self

class TypedOptionBReceipt(BaseModel):
    """Durable transaction receipt returned upon atomic batch commit."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    outcome: Literal["typed_batch"] = Field(default="typed_batch")
    batch_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    request_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    session_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    workspace_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    profile_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    n_records: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=100)
    commits: List[OptionBReceiptCommit] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    index_status: Optional[Literal["ok", "degraded"]] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="None permitted ONLY for disabled typed ACK scaffold (Task B.2); 'ok' or 'degraded' permitted after qualified activation (Task B.3+)"
    )
    committed_at_utc: str = Field(...)
    receipt_digest: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_receipt(self) -> TypedOptionBReceipt:
        # Strict ISO-8601 UTC timestamp check
        try:
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(self.committed_at_utc.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if dt.tzinfo is None:
                raise ValueError("committed_at_utc must include timezone")
        except Exception as e:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid committed_at_utc ISO-8601 timestamp: {self.committed_at_utc!r}") from e

        if self.n_records != len(self.commits):
            raise ValueError(f"n_records ({self.n_records}) != len(commits) ({len(self.commits)})")
        
        # Unique memory ID check
        commit_ids = [c.memory_id for c in self.commits]
        if len(set(commit_ids)) != len(commit_ids):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate memory_id detected in batch commits")
        
        # Batch aggregate bounds check (512 KiB)
        dumped = self.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False)
        envelope_bytes = canonical_jcs_bytes(dumped)
        if len(envelope_bytes) > 524_288:
            raise ValueError(f"Batch receipt exceeds 512 KiB limit: {len(envelope_bytes)} bytes")
        
        # Receipt digest verifies entire receipt payload excluding receipt_digest itself
        data_to_hash = {k: v for k, v in dumped.items() if k != "receipt_digest"}
        expected = sha256_canonical(data_to_hash)
        if self.receipt_digest != expected:
            raise ValueError(f"receipt_digest mismatch: expected {expected}, got {self.receipt_digest}")
        return self

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q1/Q3 Runtime HMAC Ledger Entry Model & Custody Controls
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def verify_key_custody_path(key_path: Path | str, workspace_dir: Path | str) -> Path:
    """Enforce Q1 external key custody outside memory workspace.
    
    Key must be an absolute path, regular file, non-symlink (including all parent components),
    and strictly outside workspace_dir.
    """
    if not key_path:
        raise ValueError("key_path is required")
    kp = Path(key_path)
    if not kp.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: HMAC key path must be an absolute path, got {key_path!r}")
    
    curr = kp
    while curr != curr.parent:
        if curr.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"Security violation: HMAC key path or parent component is a symlink: {curr}")
        curr = curr.parent

    ws = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    resolved = kp.resolve()
    if resolved.is_relative_to(ws):
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: HMAC key resides within workspace_dir: {resolved}")
    if not resolved.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"HMAC key file does not exist or is not a regular file: {resolved}")
    return resolved

class HmacLedgerEntry(BaseModel):
    """Cryptographic authority record for Owner Decisions (OP) & Constitutional Rules (CR)."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    entry_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    decision_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    workspace_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    profile_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=128)
    authority_tier: Literal["owner_preference", "constitutional_rule"] = Field(...)
    payload_sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    record_digest: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    memory_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    hmac_signature: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    key_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    timestamp_utc: str = Field(...)
    seq: int = Field(..., ge=1, description="Monotonically increasing sequence number for anti-replay/anti-rollback.")

def sign_hmac_entry(entry_dict: Dict[str, Any], key_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    """Generate SHA-256 HMAC signature over canonical bytes excluding signature."""
    payload = {k: v for k, v in entry_dict.items() if k != "hmac_signature"}
    data = b"FHM007-HMAC-v1:" + canonical_jcs_bytes(payload)
    return hmac.new(key_bytes, data, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

def verify_hmac_entry(entry: HmacLedgerEntry, key_bytes: bytes) -> bool:
    """Verify HMAC signature for an authority ledger entry."""
    expected = sign_hmac_entry(entry.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False), key_bytes)
    return hmac.compare_digest(entry.hmac_signature, expected)

class ExternalKeyManager:
    """External key-id to path resolver enforcing Q1 custody outside memory workspace."""

    def __init__(self, workspace_dir: Path | str, key_paths: Dict[str, Path | str]) -> None:
        self.workspace = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
        self.key_paths = {k: Path(p) for k, p in key_paths.items()}

    def resolve(self, key_id: str) -> bytes:
        if key_id not in self.key_paths:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown external HMAC key_id: {key_id}")
        verified_path = verify_key_custody_path(self.key_paths[key_id], self.workspace)
        flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
        fd = os.open(verified_path, flags)
        try:
            with open(fd, "rb", closefd=True) as handle:
                key_bytes = handle.read()
        except Exception:
            try:
                os.close(fd)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise
        if len(key_bytes) != 32:
            raise ValueError(f"HMAC key must be exactly 32 bytes, got {len(key_bytes)}")
        return key_bytes

class DurableWatermarkLedger:
    """Atomic, file-backed durable monotonic sequence tracker for owner authority streams."""

    def __init__(self, watermark_path: Path | str) -> None:
        self.path = Path(watermark_path).resolve()
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.watermarks: Dict[str, int] = {}
        if self.path.is_file():
            try:
                raw = self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                data = json.loads(raw)
                if not isinstance(data, dict):
                    raise ValueError(f"Watermark ledger root must be a JSON object, got {type(data).__name__}")
                for k, v in data.items():
                    if not isinstance(k, str) or not isinstance(v, int) or isinstance(v, bool) or v < 0:
                        raise ValueError(f"Invalid watermark entry: {k!r} -> {v!r}")
                self.watermarks = data
            except Exception as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"CORRUPT_WATERMARK_LEDGER: Durable watermark state at {self.path} is invalid or corrupt: {exc}") from exc

    def get(self, stream_key: str) -> int:
        return self.watermarks.get(stream_key, 0)

    def advance(self, stream_key: str, seq: int) -> None:
        prior = self.get(stream_key)
        if seq <= prior:
            raise ValueError(f"Ledger sequence replay or rollback: seq {seq} <= prior {prior}")
        self.watermarks[stream_key] = seq
        tmp_target = self.path.parent / f".watermarks.{os.getpid()}.tmp"
        with tmp_target.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump(self.watermarks, handle, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp_target, self.path)
        flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0)
        dir_fd = os.open(self.path.parent, flags)
        try:
            os.fsync(dir_fd)
        finally:
            os.close(dir_fd)

class LedgerVerifier:
    """Signature verifier backed by durable monotonic watermarks."""

    def __init__(self, key_manager: ExternalKeyManager, watermark_path: Optional[Path | str] = None) -> None:
        self.key_manager = key_manager
        wm_path = Path(watermark_path) if watermark_path else (self.key_manager.workspace / ".reme" / "ledger_watermarks.json")
        self.durable_ledger = DurableWatermarkLedger(wm_path)

    @staticmethod
    def stream_key(entry: HmacLedgerEntry) -> str:
        return f"{entry.workspace_id}:{entry.profile_id}:{entry.decision_id}"

    def verify(self, entry: HmacLedgerEntry, *, is_commit: bool = True, advance_watermark: bool = True) -> None:
        if entry.seq < 1 or not entry.key_id or not entry.memory_id or not entry.record_digest:
            raise ValueError("Malformed owner ledger entry")
        if not entry.workspace_id or not entry.profile_id:
            raise ValueError("Owner ledger scope is incomplete")
        key_bytes = self.key_manager.resolve(entry.key_id)
        if not verify_hmac_entry(entry, key_bytes):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid HMAC signature for entry {entry.entry_id}")
        stream = self.stream_key(entry)
        prior = self.durable_ledger.get(stream)
        if is_commit:
            if entry.seq <= prior:
                raise ValueError(f"Ledger sequence replay or rollback: seq {entry.seq} <= prior {prior}")
            if advance_watermark:
                self.durable_ledger.advance(stream, entry.seq)
        else:
            if entry.seq > prior:
                raise ValueError(f"Uncommitted future authority sequence on load: seq {entry.seq} > watermark {prior}")

def verify_runtime_owner_authority(
    record: Any,
    ledger_entries: Dict[str, HmacLedgerEntry],
    key_manager: ExternalKeyManager,
    verifier: LedgerVerifier,
    *,
    workspace_id: str,
    profile_id: Optional[str] = None,
    is_commit: bool = True,
    advance_watermark: bool = True,
) -> bool:
    """Verify Q1/Q3 runtime owner authority at commit and load with fail-closed custody, scope binding, and idempotent load verification."""
    if getattr(record, "trust_tier", None) != "owner_approved":
        return True

    authority_id = getattr(record, "authority_entry_id", None)
    if not authority_id:
        raise ValueError("Record claiming owner_approved lacks authority_entry_id")
    entry = ledger_entries.get(authority_id)
    if entry is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Authority entry {authority_id} not found in external HMAC ledger")

    rec_ws = getattr(record, "workspace_id", None)
    if not rec_ws or rec_ws != workspace_id or entry.workspace_id != workspace_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Authority scope mismatch: record workspace {rec_ws} != {workspace_id}")

    rec_prof = getattr(record, "profile_id", None)
    if not rec_prof:
        raise ValueError("Owner-approved record must have explicit profile_id")
    if profile_id and rec_prof != profile_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Authority profile mismatch with environment: {rec_prof} != {profile_id}")
    if entry.profile_id != rec_prof:
        raise ValueError(f"Authority profile mismatch: entry profile {entry.profile_id} != record {rec_prof}")

    if entry.memory_id != getattr(record, "memory_id", None):
        raise ValueError("Authority memory_id binding mismatch")
    if entry.payload_sha256 != getattr(record, "content_hash", None):
        raise ValueError("Authority payload mismatch with content_hash")
    if entry.record_digest != getattr(record, "record_digest", None):
        raise ValueError("Authority record digest mismatch")

    # Mandatory signature verification and sequence watermark validation
    verifier.verify(entry, is_commit=is_commit, advance_watermark=advance_watermark)
    return True

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q3 Contradiction Abstention & Zero-Sink Transaction Gate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class FourSinkTransaction:
    """Application-owned transaction gate managing the four durable storage sinks:
    1. Intent journal (.reme/intent_journal.jsonl)
    2. Typed notes (memory/typed/<type>/<id>.md)
    3. Option B receipts (.reme/receipts/<batch_id>.json)
    4. Lexical index directory (.reme/index/ - all files and subdirectories)
    """

    def __init__(self, workspace_dir: Path | str) -> None:
        if not workspace_dir:
            raise ValueError("workspace_dir is mandatory for FourSinkTransaction")
        self.workspace_dir = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
        if not self.workspace_dir.is_dir():
            raise ValueError(f"workspace_dir does not exist or is not a directory: {self.workspace_dir}")
        self.journal_path = self.workspace_dir / ".reme" / "intent_journal.jsonl"
        self.receipts_dir = self.workspace_dir / ".reme" / "receipts"
        self.index_dir = self.workspace_dir / ".reme" / "index"
        self.notes_dir = self.workspace_dir / "memory" / "typed"

    def snapshot_sinks(self) -> Dict[str, bytes]:
        """Byte-level snapshot of all four storage sinks."""
        sinks: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
        if self.journal_path.is_file():
            sinks[self.journal_path.relative_to(self.workspace_dir).as_posix()] = self.journal_path.read_bytes()
        for root in [self.receipts_dir, self.index_dir, self.notes_dir]:
            if root.is_dir():
                for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
                    if p.is_file():
                        sinks[p.relative_to(self.workspace_dir).as_posix()] = p.read_bytes()
        return sinks

    def admit_or_refuse(
        self,
        proposal: TypedMemoryProposal,
        approved_owner_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        *,
        ledger_entries: Optional[Dict[str, HmacLedgerEntry]] = None,
        key_manager: Optional[ExternalKeyManager] = None,
        verifier: Optional[LedgerVerifier] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Run every admission check before touching any sink. Fails closed with zero mutations."""
        before_snapshot = self.snapshot_sinks()
        try:
            if proposal.source_class in ("owner_preference", "constitutional_rule"):
                raise ValueError("Phase B strictly prohibits model-created OP/CR proposals")
            
            if approved_owner_context is not None:
                subject = approved_owner_context.get("subject")
                proposal_subject = (
                    getattr(proposal.typed_content, "entity", None)
                    or getattr(proposal.typed_content, "task_name", None)
                    or getattr(proposal.typed_content, "failure_symptom", None)
                )
                if subject and proposal_subject == subject:
                    if ledger_entries is None or key_manager is None or verifier is None:
                        raise ValueError("OWNER_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE: missing ledger, key manager, or verifier")
                    entry_id = approved_owner_context.get("entry_id")
                    if not entry_id or entry_id not in ledger_entries:
                        raise ValueError(f"OWNER_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE: missing ledger entry {entry_id}")
                    entry = ledger_entries[entry_id]
                    verifier.verify(entry, is_commit=False, advance_watermark=False)
                    if "value" in approved_owner_context and hasattr(proposal.typed_content, "value"):
                        expected_val = approved_owner_context["value"]
                        prop_val = getattr(proposal.typed_content, "value")
                        if prop_val != expected_val:
                            raise ValueError(f"OWNER_DECISION_CONTRADICTION: proposal value {prop_val!r} contradicts owner {expected_val!r}")
        except Exception:
            after_snapshot = self.snapshot_sinks()
            assert after_snapshot == before_snapshot, "Transaction violation: sink mutated during refused proposal"
            raise

def admit_or_refuse_proposal(
    proposal: TypedMemoryProposal,
    approved_owner_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    *,
    workspace_dir: Path | str,
    ledger_entries: Optional[Dict[str, HmacLedgerEntry]] = None,
    key_manager: Optional[ExternalKeyManager] = None,
    verifier: Optional[LedgerVerifier] = None,
) -> None:
    """Enforce Q3 contradiction abstention across all 4 sinks.
    
    Validates proposal before any write to journal, notes, receipts, or index.
    Fails closed on any contradiction, missing ledger, or missing key.
    workspace_dir is mandatory.
    """
    tx = FourSinkTransaction(workspace_dir)
    tx.admit_or_refuse(
        proposal,
        approved_owner_context,
        ledger_entries=ledger_entries,
        key_manager=key_manager,
        verifier=verifier,
    )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q2 Snapshot Privacy, Redaction & Encrypted Audit Retention
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class RetentionPolicy(BaseModel):
    """Owner-approved retention policy for encrypted audit snapshots."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    policy_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    approved_by_owner: bool = Field(default=False, description="Must be explicitly approved by project owner. Unapproved policies fail closed to zero destructive erasure.")
    duration_days: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=3650, description="Retention duration. No arbitrary 90-day defaults.")
    legal_holds: List[SafeId] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Active legal or incident holds blocking erasure.")
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=512)

class DurableErasureReceipt(BaseModel):
    """Immutable proof of targeted cryptographic erasure of an audit snapshot DEK."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    receipt_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    snapshot_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    dek_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    policy_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    erased_at_utc: str = Field(...)
    fsync_confirmed: bool = Field(default=True)
    receipt_digest: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")

class MemorySnapshotRecord(BaseModel):
    """Q2 audit snapshot metadata for redacted notes and encrypted audit packages."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    
    snapshot_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    memory_id: SafeId = Field(...)
    original_content_sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    redacted_content_sha256: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    was_modified: bool = Field(default=False, description="True if text redaction was required and modified content; False for honest unchanged snapshot.")
    provenance_incomplete: bool = Field(default=False)
    encrypted_audit_path: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=256)
    created_at_utc: str = Field(...)
    policy_id: Optional[SafeId] = Field(None, description="Approved retention policy ID. Missing policy fails closed to zero destructive erasure.")
    retention_policy_approved: bool = Field(default=False, description="True only with explicit owner policy approval.")
    retention_days: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=3650, description="Configurable retention duration; requires explicit owner policy decision.")
    legal_hold: bool = Field(default=False, description="When true, active legal hold permanently blocks destructive cryptographic erasure.")
    dek_id: SafeId = Field(..., description="Identifier for per-snapshot Data Encryption Key in key hierarchy.")
    erased: bool = Field(default=False)
    erasure_receipt_id: Optional[SafeId] = Field(None)
    
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_snapshot_invariants(self) -> MemorySnapshotRecord:
        if self.was_modified and self.original_content_sha256 == self.redacted_content_sha256:
            raise ValueError(
                "Invariant violation: original_content_sha256 and redacted_content_sha256 cannot be identical "
                "when was_modified=True (claimed redaction modification)"
            )
        if not self.was_modified and self.original_content_sha256 != self.redacted_content_sha256:
            raise ValueError(
                "Invariant violation: original_content_sha256 and redacted_content_sha256 must be identical "
                "when was_modified=False (honest unchanged snapshot)"
            )
        if self.retention_policy_approved:
            if not self.policy_id:
                raise ValueError("retention_policy_approved=True requires valid policy_id")
            if self.retention_days is None or self.retention_days <= 0:
                raise ValueError("retention_policy_approved=True requires explicit positive retention_days")
        if self.erased and not self.erasure_receipt_id:
            raise ValueError("erased=True requires valid erasure_receipt_id")
        return self

def redact_production_text(text: str, patterns: Optional[List[re.Pattern]] = None) -> Tuple[str, bool]:
    """Redact credentials and sensitive patterns, returning (redacted_text, was_modified)."""
    default_patterns = [
        re.compile(r"(?i)\b(?:sk_live|bearer|token|apikey|password|secret)_[0-9a-zA-Z_\-]{8,}\b"),
        re.compile(r"(?i)(password\s*[:=]\s*)['\"][^'\"]+['\"]"),
    ]
    compiled_patterns = patterns or default_patterns
    modified = False
    result = text
    for pat in compiled_patterns:
        subbed, count = pat.subn("[REDACTED:secret]", result)
        if count > 0:
            modified = True
            result = subbed
    return result, modified

def fsync_directory(directory: Path) -> None:
    """Fsync parent directory ensuring rename and file creation durability."""
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0)
    fd = os.open(directory, flags)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

SAFE_ID_REGEX = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$")

def validate_safe_id(identifier: str, name: str = "identifier") -> str:
    """Validate identifier against SafeId constraints rejecting path traversal components."""
    if not isinstance(identifier, str) or not SAFE_ID_REGEX.match(identifier):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid {name} format: {identifier!r}. Must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]+$")
    return identifier

def load_external_audit_key(key_path: Path | str, workspace_dir: Path | str) -> bytes:
    """Validate and read external audit master key ensuring custody outside workspace."""
    if not key_path:
        raise ValueError("key_path is required")
    kp = Path(key_path)
    if not kp.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: Audit key path must be an absolute path, got {key_path!r}")
    curr = kp
    while curr != curr.parent:
        if curr.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"Security violation: Audit key path or parent component is a symlink: {curr}")
        curr = curr.parent
    ws = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
    resolved = kp.resolve()
    if resolved == ws or resolved.is_relative_to(ws):
        raise ValueError(f"Security violation: Audit key resides within workspace: {resolved}")
    if not resolved.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"Audit key file does not exist or is not a regular file: {resolved}")
    key_bytes = resolved.read_bytes()
    if len(key_bytes) != 32:
        raise ValueError(f"Audit master key must be exactly 32 bytes for AES-256-GCM, got {len(key_bytes)}")
    return key_bytes

class AuditKeyManager:
    """External custody manager for audit master wrapping keys outside workspace."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        workspace_dir: Path | str,
        *,
        key_id: str = "key_audit_v1",
        key_path: Optional[Path | str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.workspace = Path(workspace_dir).resolve()
        self.key_id = validate_safe_id(key_id, "key_id")
        if key_path is None:
            raw_path = os.environ.get("FERMES_AUDIT_KEY_PATH")
            if not raw_path:
                raise ValueError("FERMES_AUDIT_KEY_PATH environment variable is required when key_path is omitted")
            configured = Path(raw_path)
        else:
            configured = Path(key_path)
        if not configured.is_absolute():
            raise ValueError(f"Security violation: Audit key path must be an absolute path, got {str(configured)!r}")
        self.key_path = configured

    def load(self) -> bytes:
        return load_external_audit_key(self.key_path, self.workspace)

    def get_key_bytes(self) -> bytes:
        return self.load()

class SnapshotKeyStore:
    """External per-snapshot DEK store with an audit-key-wrapped DEK envelope."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path | str, workspace: Path | str) -> None:
        self.root = Path(root).resolve()
        self.workspace = Path(workspace).resolve()
        if self.root == self.workspace or self.root.is_relative_to(self.workspace) or self.workspace in self.root.parents:
            raise ValueError("DEK store must be strictly external to workspace")
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, dek_id: str) -> Path:
        validate_safe_id(dek_id, "dek_id")
        target = (self.root / f"{dek_id}.json").resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(self.root):
            raise ValueError(f"Path traversal detected in dek_id: {dek_id}")
        return target

    def create(
        self,
        snapshot_id: str,
        audit_key_manager: AuditKeyManager,
        wrapping_key_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> str:
        validate_safe_id(snapshot_id, "snapshot_id")
        if not isinstance(audit_key_manager, AuditKeyManager):
            raise TypeError("audit_key_manager must be an AuditKeyManager enforcing external custody")
        wrapping_id = audit_key_manager.key_id if wrapping_key_id is None else validate_safe_id(wrapping_key_id, "wrapping_key_id")
        audit_key_bytes = audit_key_manager.get_key_bytes()

        dek_id = f"dek_{snapshot_id}_{hashlib.sha256(os.urandom(16)).hexdigest()[:12]}"
        validate_safe_id(dek_id, "dek_id")
        dek = os.urandom(32)
        nonce = os.urandom(12)
        aad = f"FHM007-DEK-v1:{dek_id}:{wrapping_id}".encode("utf-8")
        wrapped = AESGCM(audit_key_bytes).encrypt(nonce, dek, aad)
        envelope = {
            "dek_id": dek_id,
            "wrapping_key_id": wrapping_id,
            "nonce": base64.b64encode(nonce).decode("ascii"),
            "aad": base64.b64encode(aad).decode("ascii"),
            "wrapped_dek": base64.b64encode(wrapped).decode("ascii"),
        }
        target = self._path(dek_id)
        tmp_name = f".{target.name}.{os.getpid()}.tmp"
        tmp_path = target.parent / tmp_name
        with tmp_path.open("wb") as handle:
            handle.write(canonical_jcs_bytes(envelope))
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp_path, target)
        fsync_directory(self.root)
        return dek_id

    def load(
        self,
        dek_id: str,
        audit_key_manager: AuditKeyManager,
        wrapping_key_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> bytes:
        validate_safe_id(dek_id, "dek_id")
        if not isinstance(audit_key_manager, AuditKeyManager):
            raise TypeError("audit_key_manager must be an AuditKeyManager enforcing external custody")
        wrapping_id = audit_key_manager.key_id if wrapping_key_id is None else validate_safe_id(wrapping_key_id, "wrapping_key_id")
        audit_key_bytes = audit_key_manager.get_key_bytes()
        target = self._path(dek_id)
        if not target.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"Snapshot DEK unavailable: {dek_id}")
        envelope = json.loads(target.read_bytes())
        if envelope.get("wrapping_key_id") != wrapping_id:
            raise ValueError("Snapshot wrapping-key dependency mismatch")
        return AESGCM(audit_key_bytes).decrypt(
            base64.b64decode(envelope["nonce"]),
            base64.b64decode(envelope["wrapped_dek"]),
            base64.b64decode(envelope["aad"]),
        )

    def destroy(self, dek_id: str) -> None:
        validate_safe_id(dek_id, "dek_id")
        target = self._path(dek_id)
        if not target.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"Cannot destroy non-existent DEK: {dek_id}")
        target.unlink()
        fsync_directory(self.root)

def encrypt_audit_snapshot(
    workspace: Path | str,
    snapshot_id: str,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    audit_key_manager: AuditKeyManager,
    dek_store: SnapshotKeyStore,
    wrapping_key_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Path:
    """Encrypt audit snapshot with AES-256-GCM using per-snapshot DEK wrapped under external audit master key."""
    validate_safe_id(snapshot_id, "snapshot_id")
    if not isinstance(audit_key_manager, AuditKeyManager):
        raise TypeError("audit_key_manager must be an AuditKeyManager enforcing external custody")
    wrapping_id = audit_key_manager.key_id if wrapping_key_id is None else validate_safe_id(wrapping_key_id, "wrapping_key_id")
    ws = Path(workspace).resolve()
    target_dir = ws / ".reme" / "audit" / "snapshots"
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = target_dir / f"{snapshot_id}.enc"
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(target_dir):
        raise ValueError(f"Path traversal detected in snapshot_id: {snapshot_id}")
    
    dek_id = dek_store.create(snapshot_id, audit_key_manager, wrapping_id)
    dek = dek_store.load(dek_id, audit_key_manager, wrapping_id)
    nonce = os.urandom(12)
    aad = f"FHM007-AUDIT-v1:{ws.name}:{snapshot_id}:1".encode("utf-8")
    ciphertext = AESGCM(dek).encrypt(nonce, canonical_jcs_bytes(payload), aad)
    envelope = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "algorithm": "AES-256-GCM",
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "dek_id": dek_id,
        "wrapping_key_id": wrapping_id,
        "nonce": base64.b64encode(nonce).decode("ascii"),
        "aad": base64.b64encode(aad).decode("ascii"),
        "ciphertext": base64.b64encode(ciphertext).decode("ascii"),
        "ciphertext_sha256": hashlib.sha256(ciphertext).hexdigest(),
    }
    tmp_name = f".{target.name}.{os.getpid()}.tmp"
    tmp_path = target_dir / tmp_name
    with tmp_path.open("wb") as handle:
        handle.write(canonical_jcs_bytes(envelope))
        handle.flush()
        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp_path, target)
    fsync_directory(target_dir)
    return target

def decrypt_audit_snapshot(
    workspace: Path | str,
    snapshot_id: str,
    audit_key_manager: AuditKeyManager,
    dek_store: SnapshotKeyStore,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Decrypt audit snapshot with authenticated verification using wrapped DEK."""
    validate_safe_id(snapshot_id, "snapshot_id")
    if not isinstance(audit_key_manager, AuditKeyManager):
        raise TypeError("audit_key_manager must be an AuditKeyManager enforcing external custody")
    ws = Path(workspace).resolve()
    target_dir = ws / ".reme" / "audit" / "snapshots"
    target = target_dir / f"{snapshot_id}.enc"
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(target_dir):
        raise ValueError(f"Path traversal detected in snapshot_id: {snapshot_id}")
    if not target.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"Snapshot ciphertext file missing: {target}")
    envelope = json.loads(target.read_bytes())
    if envelope.get("algorithm") != "AES-256-GCM" or envelope.get("snapshot_id") != snapshot_id:
        raise ValueError("Invalid or mismatched snapshot envelope")
    ciphertext = base64.b64decode(envelope["ciphertext"])
    if hashlib.sha256(ciphertext).hexdigest() != envelope.get("ciphertext_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("Snapshot ciphertext SHA-256 mismatch")
    wrapping_key_id = envelope.get("wrapping_key_id", audit_key_manager.key_id)
    dek = dek_store.load(envelope["dek_id"], audit_key_manager, wrapping_key_id)
    plaintext = AESGCM(dek).decrypt(
        base64.b64decode(envelope["nonce"]),
        ciphertext,
        base64.b64decode(envelope["aad"]),
    )
    return json.loads(plaintext.decode("utf-8"))

def evaluate_audit_erasure(
    policy: Optional[RetentionPolicy],
    created_at: Optional[datetime.datetime],
    now: datetime.datetime,
    snapshot: MemorySnapshotRecord,
) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Evaluate whether an audit snapshot DEK may be destroyed under approved policy and mandatory snapshot metadata."""
    if not isinstance(snapshot, MemorySnapshotRecord):
        raise TypeError("snapshot: MemorySnapshotRecord is mandatory for audit erasure evaluation")
    if policy is None:
        return False, "UNAPPROVED_POLICY: missing policy fails closed to zero erasure"
    if not policy.approved_by_owner:
        return False, "UNAPPROVED_POLICY: policy has not been approved by project owner"
    if snapshot.legal_hold:
        return False, f"LEGAL_HOLD: active snapshot legal_hold blocks erasure on snapshot {snapshot.snapshot_id}"
    if policy.legal_holds:
        return False, f"LEGAL_HOLD: active legal holds block erasure: {policy.legal_holds}"
    if not policy.duration_days or policy.duration_days <= 0:
        return False, "INVALID_RETENTION: approved duration_days required"
    if not snapshot.retention_policy_approved or not snapshot.policy_id:
        return False, "UNAPPROVED_POLICY: snapshot metadata indicates retention policy is not approved by owner"
    if snapshot.policy_id != policy.policy_id:
        return False, f"POLICY_MISMATCH: supplied policy_id {policy.policy_id} contradicts snapshot metadata policy_id {snapshot.policy_id}"
    if snapshot.retention_days is not None and policy.duration_days != snapshot.retention_days:
        return False, f"DURATION_MISMATCH: supplied policy duration {policy.duration_days} contradicts snapshot metadata retention_days {snapshot.retention_days}"

    # Authenticate and bind created_at from canonical snapshot metadata
    snap_created_str = getattr(snapshot, "created_at_utc", None)
    if not snap_created_str:
        return False, "INVALID_METADATA: snapshot record missing created_at_utc"
    snap_dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(snap_created_str)
    if snap_dt.tzinfo is None:
        snap_dt = snap_dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    if created_at is not None:
        c_dt = created_at if created_at.tzinfo is not None else created_at.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        if abs((snap_dt - c_dt).total_seconds()) > 1.0:
            return False, f"TIMESTAMP_MISMATCH: caller created_at {created_at} contradicts snapshot metadata {snap_created_str}"

    now_dt = now if now.tzinfo is not None else now.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    expires_at = snap_dt + datetime.timedelta(days=policy.duration_days)
    if now_dt < expires_at:
        return False, f"RETENTION_ACTIVE: snapshot unexpired until {expires_at.isoformat()}"
    return True, "ERASURE_PERMITTED"

def write_durable_erasure_receipt(workspace: Path | str, snapshot_id: str, receipt: DurableErasureReceipt) -> Path:
    """Atomically write, file-fsync, and directory-fsync an erasure receipt."""
    validate_safe_id(snapshot_id, "snapshot_id")
    validate_safe_id(receipt.receipt_id, "receipt_id")
    receipt_dir = Path(workspace).resolve() / ".reme" / "audit" / "erasure_receipts"
    receipt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = receipt_dir / f"{receipt.receipt_id}.json"
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(receipt_dir):
        raise ValueError(f"Path traversal detected in receipt_id: {receipt.receipt_id}")
    temp_path = receipt_dir / f".{receipt.receipt_id}.{os.getpid()}.tmp"
    data = canonical_jcs_bytes(receipt.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False))
    with temp_path.open("wb") as handle:
        handle.write(data)
        handle.flush()
        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
    os.replace(temp_path, target)
    fsync_directory(receipt_dir)
    return target

def cryptographic_erase_snapshot(
    workspace: Path | str,
    snapshot_id: str,
    dek_store: SnapshotKeyStore,
    *,
    policy: RetentionPolicy,
    created_at: Optional[datetime.datetime] = None,
    now: datetime.datetime,
    snapshot: MemorySnapshotRecord,
) -> DurableErasureReceipt:
    """Execute targeted cryptographic erasure destroying both ciphertext and DEK with atomic durable receipt and mandatory snapshot validation."""
    validate_safe_id(snapshot_id, "snapshot_id")
    if not isinstance(snapshot, MemorySnapshotRecord):
        raise TypeError("snapshot: MemorySnapshotRecord is mandatory for cryptographic erasure")
    if snapshot.snapshot_id != snapshot_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Snapshot record id mismatch: {snapshot.snapshot_id} != {snapshot_id}")
    if snapshot.legal_hold:
        raise ValueError(f"Erasure prohibited: LEGAL_HOLD on snapshot {snapshot_id}")
    
    allowed, reason = evaluate_audit_erasure(policy, created_at, now, snapshot)
    if not allowed:
        raise ValueError(f"Erasure prohibited: {reason}")
    ws = Path(workspace).resolve()
    target_dir = ws / ".reme" / "audit" / "snapshots"
    snapshot_path = target_dir / f"{snapshot_id}.enc"
    if not snapshot_path.resolve().is_relative_to(target_dir):
        raise ValueError(f"Path traversal detected in snapshot_id: {snapshot_id}")
    if not snapshot_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot erase non-existent snapshot envelope: {snapshot_path}")
    envelope = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_bytes())
    dek_id = envelope.get("dek_id")
    if not dek_id:
        raise ValueError("Snapshot envelope missing dek_id")
    validate_safe_id(dek_id, "dek_id")
    
    # Construct and publish durable erasure receipt first to guarantee crash-consistent auditability
    receipt_id = f"erx_{snapshot_id}"
    validate_safe_id(receipt_id, "receipt_id")
    receipt_dict = {
        "receipt_id": receipt_id,
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "dek_id": dek_id,
        "policy_id": policy.policy_id,
        "erased_at_utc": now.isoformat(),
        "fsync_confirmed": True,
    }
    receipt_digest = sha256_canonical(receipt_dict)
    receipt_dict["receipt_digest"] = receipt_digest
    receipt = DurableErasureReceipt(**receipt_dict)
    write_durable_erasure_receipt(ws, snapshot_id, receipt)

    # With durable receipt safely committed and fsynced, execute cryptographic erasure
    snapshot_path.unlink()
    fsync_directory(snapshot_path.parent)
    dek_store.destroy(dek_id)
    
    return receipt
